newsitem.title: UK: Stella Artois in film sponsorship programme.
newsitem.headline: Stella Artois in film sponsorship programme.

text.p: Stella Artois, a lager brewed in the UK by Whitbread Plc, on Monday said it launched a 25 million pound movie entertainment programme designed to increase its market share.
It said the so-called Stella Screen programme was the largest-ever UK multi-media campaign for a beer brand.

The programme will include sponsorship of films broadcast on Britain's Channel 4 and the new Channel 5, an eight-city free outdoor movie tour, sponsorship of Virgin Radio's "Big Screen" nightly film news roundup and cinema adertising featuring the brand's "Reassuringly Expensive" campaign.
Channel 5 in January had said it signed a 1.3 million pound deal with Stella Artois for sponsorship of films when the new channel begins broadcasting on March 30.

Stella Artois said it would also sponsor films on Channel 4 in June and July. The Stella Screen programme will also include creation of a Stella Artois film guide to be inserted into 10 magazines published by EMAP Plc and a student film competition.
